'''Skeleton warrior''' is a [[monster]].

They are conjured by [[Zemouregal]] when the player's expedition party reach the tower on [[Ungael]] during [[Ancient Awakening]], and are seen as non-attackable characters before the waves in the tower start. It is currently unknown if the player can fight these monsters.
